hook.name: AgroLastro PoolAGL
hook.description: Manages the official AGL/USDC Uniswap v4 pool exclusively: gates pool initialization and liquidity provision to the hook itself (locking liquidity permanently). afterSwap records AGL net flow into transient storage (EIP-1153) for the token's internal quota system without altering swap amounts. Fixed 2% LP fee, collectable by anyone, withdrawable only by the designated fee recipient.
